Server Data

group FIRMWARE_UPDATE_SERVER_DATA

Structures and data types for server-side operations.

Defines

FW_UPDATE_SERVER_METADATA_CHECK 0

Metadata check. Uses fw_update_server_metadata_check_t.

FW_UPDATE_SERVER_START 1

Update start. Uses fw_update_server_start_t.

FW_UPDATE_SERVER_VERIFY 2

Update verification. Uses fw_update_server_verify_t.

FW_UPDATE_SERVER_VERIFY_CANCEL 3

Verification cancel. Uses fw_update_server_verify_cancel_t.

FW_UPDATE_SERVER_APPLY 4

Update apply. Uses fw_update_server_apply_t.

FW_UPDATE_SERVER_BLOCK_DATA 5

Block data. Uses fw_update_server_block_data_t.

FW_UPDATE_SERVER_FAIL 6

Failure. Uses fw_update_server_fail_t.
